source_name: AMIK — Association of Microfinance Institutions of Kosovo (member list & sector data)
source_subtype: industry association member list + sector statistics
why_relevant: Names every MFI in Kosovo and publishes sector aggregates (e.g. ~EUR 289m active loans across ~105k clients as of mid-2023) that BQK reports only in coarser form; complements the banking association for the non-bank lending universe.

source_name: FSDK — Fondi i Sigurimit të Depozitave në Kosovë (Deposit Insurance Fund) member banks
why_relevant: Membership is mandatory for every BQK-licensed bank, so FSDK's member list is an independent, continuously maintained roster of deposit-taking banks; its premium pages also expose per-bank scale indicators.

source_name: BKS — Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit (Kosovo Insurance Bureau)
source_subtype: insurance bureau member list + sector statistics
why_relevant: Names all insurers operating in Kosovo (compulsory MTPL members) and publishes premium/claims/policy-count aggregates — the insurance half of the 'sector=both' scope and a source of actor names outside the banking register.

source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës / gzk.rks-gov.net (Official Gazette legal register)
why_relevant: Authoritative index of the laws and BQK regulations that create reporting obligations (Law 04/L-093 on banks/MFIs/NBFIs; Law 04/L-155 on the payment system; Law 08/L-304 on banks) — tells you which statistics must legally exist and who must file them.

source_name: BQK — Serbian-language regulatory repository (korniza_ligjore/srpski)
why_relevant: BQK publishes its legal framework and some institution lists in Serbian; this path is the entry point for sr-language coverage of the same registers, important for the Serb-majority north and for sr-language search terms.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (Kosovo Chamber of Commerce)
why_relevant: Cross-sector membership body with regional units; its member directory and sector analyses name merchant-side and service-provider actors (POS acceptance, retail) that no financial register lists.

source_name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association member directory
why_relevant: Claims 200+ members covering ~90% of Kosovo's ICT market; the member list is the practical way to identify fintech/payment-technology vendors and POS/software integrators that never appear in BQK registers.

source_name: BQK Edukimi Financiar sub-site (bqk-kos.org/edu) — archived institution lists & FAQ
why_relevant: Separate WordPress instance that hosts older editions of the licensed-institutions list and plain-language explanations of which institution types exist; useful for historical actor-universe reconstruction and for terminology.

source_name: eKosova / rbk.rks-gov.net — government e-services and business registration front-end
why_relevant: The transactional layer of the business registry; confirms which registry services are digitised and is the gateway through which entity data is filed — relevant for understanding data freshness and structure of ARBK records.

source_name: World Bank Global Findex Database — download data (country-level XLSX/CSV/DTA)
source_subtype: IFI statistical dataset / survey data download
why_relevant: Canonical demand-side financial inclusion micro/aggregate data including Kosovo: account ownership, debit/credit card ownership, digital payments made/received, cash-only behaviour. Machine-readable country-level files for 2011, 2014, 2017, 2021, 2024 waves — the only cross-country comparable demand-side cash-usage measure for Kosovo.

source_name: Global Findex Database 2025 microdata (World Bank Microdata Library, catalog 7860)
why_relevant: Respondent-level Findex 2025/2024-wave microdata covering 141 economies incl. Kosovo. Allows custom cuts (card ownership by age/income/urban-rural, cash-usage segments) impossible from headline indicators.

source_name: World Bank Data360 — Global Findex dataset page + Data360 API
why_relevant: Programmatic, disaggregated access to Findex indicators (and other WB-hosted datasets) with a beta API — the cleanest automation path for recurring Kosovo indicator pulls.

source_name: World Bank Open Data — Kosovo country page (WDI indicators incl. ATMs per 100k adults)
why_relevant: WDI republishes IMF FAS-derived indicators such as FB.ATM.TOTL.P5 (ATMs per 100,000 adults) for Kosovo with a stable, well-documented indicators API — low-friction backbone series.

source_name: World Bank Digital Finance country dashboard — Kosovo
why_relevant: Country snapshot combining digital-payment indicators and enabling-regulation status for Kosovo; a compact cross-check on payments/digital-adoption indicators and a pointer to underlying WB datasets.

source_name: World Bank — Retail Payment Costs and Savings in Kosovo (February 2022)
why_relevant: Kosovo-specific WB cost-of-retail-payments study using PSDG methodology, with primary survey data from households, businesses, 9 commercial banks, CBK, 4 MTOs and the Post — the richest available quantification of cash usage and cash cost in Kosovo.

source_name: World Bank Global Payment Systems Survey (GPSS) dataset
why_relevant: Central-bank-reported quantitative and qualitative payment-system data (infrastructure, retail instruments, oversight, remittances) covering 100+ authorities; supply-side complement to Findex for Kosovo payment-system structure.

source_name: World Bank Enterprise Survey — Kosovo 2025 (microdata catalog 8257)
why_relevant: Firm-level supply/demand-side data on access to finance, bank account and credit use, and payment behaviour of Kosovo firms; the merchant-side counterpart to Findex household data (relevant to POS acceptance).

source_name: IMF Financial Access Survey (FAS) — data portal dataset
why_relevant: Primary harmonised supply-side access series for Kosovo: ATMs per 100,000 adults, POS terminals, commercial bank branches, accounts and card transaction volumes; 2004–latest, annual, machine-readable; now extended with fintech pilot variables in which Kosovo was a top reporter.

source_name: IMF FAS Annual Report (latest edition PDF)
why_relevant: Narrative + methodology companion to the FAS dataset; documents definitions (what counts as a POS terminal), coverage changes and reporting quality — essential for interpreting Kosovo series breaks.

source_name: DBnomics mirror of IMF/FAS
why_relevant: Third-party structured mirror of the full FAS series with a stable free API — practical automation fallback when the IMF portal blocks or re-platforms, includes Kosovo series.

source_name: FRED — IMF FAS Kosovo geographical outreach series (e.g. KOSFCAANUM ATMs per 100,000 adults)
why_relevant: Kosovo-specific FAS series exposed as clean, versioned FRED time series with CSV/API access and revision history — the lowest-friction way to track Kosovo ATM/branch density over time.

source_name: IMF Kosovo country page (Article IV, SBA/RSF reviews, staff reports)
why_relevant: Master index of all IMF Kosovo documents — Article IV staff reports with statistical annexes (banking sector, credit-to-GDP, payment-law reform), concluding statements, and programme reviews. Best single monitoring hook for IMF output on Kosovo.

source_name: IMF eLibrary — Kosovo staff country reports and selected issues papers
why_relevant: Structured HTML/XML access to Kosovo staff reports and selected-issues chapters (e.g. 'Using Digitalization to Enhance Public Finance in Kosovo'), easier to parse than PDFs and useful for topic-level retrieval on digital payments.

source_name: EBRD Business Environment and Enterprise Performance Survey (BEEPS) — data and reports
why_relevant: EBRD-EIB-WBG joint firm survey; the 2018-2020 round covered ~28,000 firms across 41 economies including Kosovo, with access-to-finance and bank-usage modules — cross-country comparable enterprise-side evidence.

source_name: EBRD Banking Environment and Performance Survey (BEPS III)
why_relevant: Survey of bank CEOs/heads of credit across EBRD regions (waves 2006, 2012, 2020-21) — supply-side strategy and lending-behaviour intelligence. Underlying microdata is NOT public due to bank confidentiality, so value is in the published research outputs.

source_name: EIB CESEE Bank Lending Survey (surveys & data hub)
why_relevant: Semi-annual survey of ~15 international banking groups and ~85 local subsidiaries covering >50% of banking assets, with Kosovo explicitly among covered countries; gives forward-looking credit supply/demand and profitability signals for Kosovo banks twice a year.

source_name: IFC — Kosovo digital financial services programme (IFC/SECO with CBK)
source_subtype: IFI programme announcement / advisory project pointer
why_relevant: Signals an active IFC/SECO advisory programme with CBK on payment-services law, open banking and digital finance — such programmes typically generate diagnostics, market assessments and workshop data on Kosovo payments; a lead-generator for future primary documents.
